title: Bilinear embedding for divergence-form operators with first-order terms and negative potentials
summary: This article establishes a bilinear embedding for second-order divergence-form operators with complex coefficients, characterized by the simultaneous presence of first-order terms and negative potentials. This work provides a further development of the theory initiated by Carbonaro and Dragičević for the homogeneous case, and recently extended by the second author to cases where first-order terms or negative potentials were treated in isolation.
